rendered: For the LDA of the bacterial clusters, the score plot (Fig. 2[1] panel e) is built on the principal discriminant factors. The text gives their shares as account for 99.9% and 0.1% of the total variance[2], respectively. Taken together, the pair of factors accounts for all of the total variance: the first carries 99.9%[3] and the second 0.1%[4]. The panel axes are labelled the same way: Factor 1 (99.9%) and Factor 2 (0.1%)[5].
